name: Disruption Of A Causal Organism
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The drug disrupts the causal organism The pinned descendant closure is biolink:disrupts.; The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.
hypothesis: Disruption of a disease-causing organism may supply direct anti-infective action.

nodes.role: Organism asserted to cause the disease
nodes.explanation: Organism asserted to cause the disease.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The drug disrupts the causal organism The pinned descendant closure is biolink:disrupts.

edges.subject: organism
edges.explanation: The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.

mechanism.rationale: Disruption of a disease-causing organism may supply direct anti-infective action. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[disruption:{{relationship_types:disruption}}]->(organism:OrganismTaxon) WHERE disruption.predicate IN {{predicates:disruption}} MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[infection:{{relationship_types:infection}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE infection.predicate IN {{predicates:infection}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT organism) AS support_count

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
